shortDescription: Allows the locking and unlocking of resource groups on VSP block storage systems.

options.name: connection_info
options.description: Information required to establish a connection to the storage system.

options.name: secondary_connection_info
options.description: Information required to establish a connection to the remote storage system.

options.name: spec
options.description: Specification for the resource group lock.

options.name: state
options.description: Set state to C(present) for locking resource group. Set state to C(absent) for unlocking resource group.

options.name: storage_system_info
options.description: Information about the storage system. This field is an optional field.
